app_fee.value: International applicants pay a non-refundable $90 Texas A&M fee plus a separate application-service (CAS) processing fee; program records show totals where stated.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable $90 application fee (in addition to a centralized application service processing fee) is required to process an application for admission.

fee_waiver.value: The $90 international application fee cannot be waived at university level; a few departments offer their own help (see program records).
fee_waiver.quote: Waiver of the $90 international application fee is not available.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 overall for tests taken before January 21, 2026, or 4.5 on the new scale (with 4.0 in each section) for tests from that date; MyBest scores are not accepted. Some departments set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL iBT overall score of 80 (in person or Home Edition) taken prior to January 21, 2026 | Minimum TOEFL iBT overall score of 4.5 (in person or Home Edition) taken on or after January 21, 2026, and from a test date within two years WITH a 4.0 minimum score required on each individual skill section | Some academic units may establish testing standards that exceed the University’s minimum score for admission to their programs.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall from a test within two years; IELTS General and One Skill Retake are not accepted for admission.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum IELTS Academic test score of 6.0 overall band from a test date within two years

english_waiver.value: Only citizens of listed English-speaking countries (India is not one) or holders of a full US bachelor's or master's are exempt, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: This is attainable by achieving a minimum required score on an acceptable standardized examination, citizenship with an English-speaking country, or completion of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree at an accredited academic institution within the United States. | If you are a citizen of one of the following countries, you will meet the English Language Proficiency Requirement for admission

notes: Most programs apply through GraduateCAS; College of Engineering programs use EngineeringCAS ($90 + $58 for internationals). International graduate assistants who teach must also meet a higher English certification standard (ELPE or TOEFL/IELTS speaking scores).
